cases.question: Does an LFMC need a CMS licence?
cases.answer: MAS rule explanation: A company conducting fund management activities regulated under the Securities and Futures Act 2001 must apply to be a licensed fund management company holding a Capital Markets Services licence. A company that can operate under an existing class exemption does not require a licence.

citations.title: Fund Management Licensing | Monetary Authority of Singapore

evidence.quote: If your company wishes to conduct fund management activities regulated under the Securities and Futures Act 2001 (SFA), it must apply to be a licensed fund management company (LFMC) that holds a Capital Markets Services (CMS) licence.
If your company is able to operate under an existing class exemption, it does not require a licence.
